meta.description: Gives the paths and meshes that pass through a color: white flesh, pink gills, a yolk-yellow chanterelle. Every path of the nodes that made them gets it in hyphae_to_mesh, and where it meets a path of another color the color goes over smoothly. Paths without a color keep the viewer's material. Connect mix_color to let the color follow time.

plant.description: The paths, they pass through unchanged

mesh.label: Mesh
mesh.description: A mesh to color all over, like the plates of lamellae or the skin of membrane, or a list of meshes from a join node, for the meshes input of hyphae_to_mesh
